## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(2)` | `2` |   | RTCP version (2). |
| `padding` | `uint(1)` | `0` |   | P bit: padding octets at the end of the packet (Manual). |
| `count` | `uint(5)` | `0` |   | Count / format field (5 bits) of a packet type that is not typed. |
| `packet_type` | `enum(8)` | `205` (rtpfb) |   | Packet type (200 SR, 201 RR, 202 SDES, 203 BYE, 204 APP, 205 RTPFB, 206 PSFB, 207 XR). |
| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header in 32-bit words (`-1`) | Packet length in 32-bit words minus one (Auto). |
| `body` | `bytes` — up to offset `length * 4 + 4` of the group | `12 34 56 78 00 00 00 00` |   | Packet body after the common header, as octets. |
